questions.q: Which of the following constitutes a basic legal obligation of an employer toward their employee?
options: To ensure the employee's personal bank accounts are well funded.
To provide a safe, healthy, and hazard-free working environment.
To strictly dictate the employee's political party affiliations.
To guarantee the employee lifetime employment regardless of conduct.
questions.explain: Employers have a statutory and common law duty of care to their employees, which primarily includes providing a **safe working environment**, proper equipment, safe systems of work, and paying agreed wages.
